new_seed_training_review: The first continuous three-evaluation run at AbsRel<=0.09 starts1000 and confirms1200 at631.28477s. This is the first completed run in this study to meet that target; it does not imply the threshold remains satisfied to the end. Target0.10 starts100 and confirms300 at165.65109s.

Significant-improvement anchor and raw best both1400; stop2400 after ten stale checks. Stable step remains null, including a final score outside1% of best. Ten post-best observations are retained, maximum0.09076924 at2200.

The train curve continues downward after the validation minimum while validation rises and oscillates; the prespecified late-loss-down/validation-up indicator is true. This is consistent with mild overfitting, not an explosive numerical collapse or a proven sole mechanism.

2400 attempted/2398 successful updates;19200 exposures,38.4 effective epochs. Two AMP skips at28 and1836, no recorded failure/restart. A post-best skip is logged but temporal association alone does not explain the endpoint drift.

interpretation: With two seeds, L500 has no established overall AbsRel increment over L400, and shows better edge-band metric depth but lower edge-detection F1. The second seed reaches the stringent accuracy target yet is not stable at stopping. Its positive endpoint F1 change requires revising any first-seed-only generalization of boundary decline. Keep the two-seed result provisional.
